 Order

18.10.2023 Heard Shri H. Agarwal, learned counsel for the petitioner, namely, Shri Abhishek Jha,
who has filed this application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking regular bail in connection with Sessions (Spl.) Case No. 160/2023 and Fatashil Ambari P.S. Case No. 111/2023 registered under Sections 417/376 (1/2)/506/323/427 of the IPC.
The petitioner was arrested on 25.05.2023.
This Court has been informed that the charge sheet has been submitted.

Call for the scanned copy of the case records from Special Judge (POCSO), Kamrup (M), Guwahati.
Registry
to issue necessary requisition for the same.

Shri K. Baishya, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor is present for the respondent no.
1. Steps to be taken for service of notice upon the respondent no. 2.
Steps by registered post with A/D.
It is submitted that in the cause list the name of the petitioner has incorrectly been written as Abhishek Jain instead of Abhishek Jha.
Registry to note the same and make necessary corrections and put the correct name in the cause list when the case is listed next.
